note: What survives the method vocabulary in the core package odoo/, one entry per name with the reason it is not a violation. ADR-0082 established that this is a list and not a package boundary; ADR-0083 kept it one. There is no --update: an entry is argued, never banked. A name here must be reachable by the gate -- an entry no definition answers to is dead weight, and test_naming_core_vocabulary asserts none is.

names.fetch: reserved -- the ORM read operation that loads stored values into the cache (§2.4.3)
names._fetch_field: reserved -- fetch()'s internals are one contract with it, renamed together or not at all
names._fetch_query: reserved -- as _fetch_field; _get_query would promise a Query return
names.append_paths: reserved -- both halves of the _append_ reservation hold: an ordered list, and an addition at its end, beside an insert_paths that takes the index
names.ensure_db_endpoint: noun -- ensure_db is the route flag declared in addons/web, not a verb
names.remove_control_characters: noun -- a control character is a character
names._read_group_fill_temporal: noun -- fill_temporal is a read_group parameter and a context key
names._check_on_delete_required_m2o: noun -- on_delete is a field on ir.model.fields
